messages.deny_full_read: harness-habits: {path} has {lines} lines (limit {max}). A line range keeps output bounded, for example: sed -n '1,{head}p' {path}
messages.deny_follow: harness-habits: `tail {flag}` never returns. `tail -n {head} {path}` shows the end once.
messages.rewrite_note: harness-habits appended `| head -n {head}` to bound the output.
messages.advise_unbounded: harness-habits: `{cmd}` in this pipeline has no output bound. `| head -n {head}`, `-l` or `-c` keeps the result small.
messages.advise_read: harness-habits: {path} has {lines} lines. Read without `limit` loads all of them; `offset`/`limit` or a grep first keeps context small.
